mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous weekly improvement in TRANSIT (+3.6 pts) and WORKPLACES (+4.9 pts) in the week ending t-0 marks the onset of a commuting-routine rebuild. Because routine formation lags the raw mobility signal by two to three weeks, weekday retail footfall mechanically follows, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks above the -43.6 prior-28-day mean.
failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve week-on-week, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the following 28 days is not higher than the preceding 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS acts as the substitution outlet for discretionary time: the t-3w spike to +45.7 coincided with the RETAIL_REC trough at -44.9, and the collapse to +11.6 in t-1w immediately preceded the retail rebound to -42.3. Once PARKS falls below +25, outdoor-only recreation loses its pull and spending rotates back indoors, lifting RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls below +25 after having exceeded +40 in the prior three weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 45.7 (t-3w) to 11.6 (t-1w) then rose to 22.4 (t-0w)
regime_hint: spring reopening with warm-weather outdoor substitution
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior-14-day mean in the two weeks following a PARKS week-mean that drops below +25 after exceeding +40.

mechanism_narrative: Retail recovery requires joint release of two binding constraints: the commuting channel (TRANSIT, WORKPLACES) and the staying-home channel (RESIDENTIAL). Only when RESIDENTIAL falls while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise in the same week does the composite out-of-home index clear the level supporting higher retail footfall; single-series improvements are insufficient.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL declines week-on-week while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 13.9 (t-1w) to 11.9 (t-0w) while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rose
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL falls and TRANSIT plus WORKPLACES rise together, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not above the prior-28-day mean.

PARKS is the leading expression of that seasonal shift, and its persistent positive level (above +10 in all four weeks) implies RETAIL_REC inherits the same seasonal component over the next two weeks.
